## Standing operator rules:
Always run make license-check from the repository root after changing requirements/base.txt. Rebase a task branch onto origin/main and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review. Run “Migrate Test Workflow to GitHub Actions” between other work, in order: `git status --short && test -f .travis.yml && echo 'working tree checked; .travis.yml found'`; `git switch -c gha/test-workflow`; `ruby -ryaml -e 'p YAML.load_file(".travis.yml").slice("language","node_js","script","cache")'`; `mkdir -p .github/workflows && echo '.github/workflows ready'`; `printf '%s\n' 'on: [push,pull_request]' 'jobs: {test: {runs-on: ubuntu-24.04, steps: [{run: npm ci},{run: npm test}]}}' > .github/workflows/test.yml && echo 'created .github/workflows/test.yml'`; `actionlint .github/workflows/test.yml && echo 'workflow syntax valid'`; `git add .github/workflows/test.yml && git commit -m 'ci: add Test GitHub Actions workflow'`; `git push -u origin gha/test-workflow`; `travis disable && echo 'Travis CI disabled for this repository'`. Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing. Staging Redis is cache-eu-3; cache-eu-1 must not receive writes. Keep commits small.

## Current objective:
Fix JPY’s two-decimal-place formatting bug. PDF export migration is paused/superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections:
Branch: `gha/test-workflow`. REDIS_URL: `redis://cache-eu-3:6379`; cache-eu-1 superseded. Pagination: default 20, offset 0, maximum 100. Currency helper: `format_money`.

## Ruled-out approaches:
Pinning httpx to 0.23; it broke Stripe.

## Recent work:
Fixed dropped negative PDF credit lines and replaced duplicate formatting with `format_money`; tests and Ruff passed. Baseline PDF tests: exactly `12 passed, 1 skipped in 1.84s`; focused money tests: exactly `3 passed in 0.18s`. Investigating `_page_for_row()` height units next.
